page.overview:
Who is 513 (LMD)?

When MODOK Superior speculated that the mysterious signal belonged to a stealth vehicle, 513 suggested that the unidentified party might be connected to the ongoing invasion of New York. MODOK considered this possible, but ultimately dismissed the idea. Based on his experience, he concluded that the mysterious presence was specifically pursuing Red Hulk and was merely taking advantage of the chaos caused by the invasion.

The unidentified figure was in fact Black Fog, who had been following Red Hulk and intended to use his battle against the Thing, empowered by the Hammer of Angrir, as an opportunity to kill him.
